axis: +X from the west Great Gatehouse and Base Court through Clock Court to the Baroque Fountain Court and garden façade. +Z runs toward the Thames side.
limitations: The palace perimeter, seven court voids, named hall and chapel footprints, and three mapped passage centerlines use PMTiles. Standard viewer terrain determines the gate, bridge and court levels.

Roof pitches, chimney positions, window subdivisions, the heraldic stonework and the astronomical dial are exterior reconstructions from ordinary photographs. The fountain is static and rooms beyond the open passages and cloister are outside the scope.
